llm_response.reason: Multiple scam indicators are present: the site copies the branding of a legitimate designer (Pedro Miralles) but lacks standard navigation or business details, is missing typical e-commerce hyperlinks, and offers high discounts (up to 80%). Search results include user warnings of pre-orders that never deliver and clear advice from multiple independent sources to avoid the site. There is an absence of identifiable ownership, business contacts, or verified reviews, all consistent with characteristics of fake online shopping scams.
